allowed     : rupee amount the policy should pay for this line, as a number.
clause_id   : the clause that decides it, copied exactly from clauses.json.
needs_human : true when no clause in this policy decides the line, else false.
When needs_human is true, leave allowed and clause_id as null.
expected_total_allowed: the final payable figure after proportionate deduction,
co-payment and the sum insured cap have been applied.
policy_schedule: the insured's own room entitlement, when they supplied it.
null means it was left blank - a room-rent line that depends on it
must then come back needs_human, not a guess.
Run 'uv run python eval/helper.py B01' to see the bill and the candidate clauses.
eval/verify_clauses.md lists every clause these bills depend on, to check by eye.
Nothing in this file may be generated by the system under test.
